defs.en: Deprived of sight; blind.
Transmitting, reflecting, or receiving inadequate light to render timely discernment or comprehension
Dull or deeper in hue; not bright or light.
defs.ex: My sister’s hair is darker than mine.

defs.en: A complete or (more often) partial absence of light.
defs.ex: Dark surrounds us completely.

defs.en: Ignorance.
defs.ex: We kept him in the dark.

defs.en: Nightfall.
defs.ex: It was after dark before we got to playing baseball.

defs.en: A dark shade or dark passage in a painting, engraving, etc.
To grow or become dark, darken.
To remain in the dark, lurk, lie hidden or concealed.
To make dark, darken; to obscure.
An administrative division of an area.
defs.ex: Soho is a district of London

defs.en: An area or region marked by some distinguishing feature.
defs.ex: the Lake District in Cumbria

defs.en: An administrative division of a county without the status of a borough.
defs.ex: South Oxfordshire District Council

defs.en: A specific, usually named area of the coalface where particular seams are worked.
To divide into administrative or other districts.
defs.ex: A county districted for voting purposes.

defs.en: The quality of being different.
defs.ex: You need to learn to be more tolerant of difference.

defs.en: A characteristic of something that makes it different from something else.
defs.ex: There are three differences between these two pictures.

defs.en: A disagreement or argument.
defs.ex: We have our little differences, but we are firm friends.

defs.en: Significant change in or effect on a situation or state.
defs.ex: It just won't make much difference to me.

defs.en: The result of a subtraction; sometimes the absolute value of this result.
defs.ex: The difference between 3 and 21 is 18.

ja: 異なる点や性質。違い、異質、差異、相異点。

defs.en: to modify a heraldic emblem so as to distinguish one branch of a house from another

ja: 区別する。殊別する。識別する。見分ける。

defs.en: Made up of two matching or complementary elements.
defs.ex: The closet has double doors.

defs.en: Of twice the quantity.
defs.ex: Give me a double serving of mashed potatoes.

defs.en: Of a family relationship, related on both the maternal and paternal sides of a family.
defs.ex: He's my double cousin as my mother's sister married my father's brother.

defs.en: Designed for two (people, cars, etc.).
defs.ex: a double room

defs.en: Folded in two; composed of two layers.
Twice over; twofold; doubly.
defs.ex: February 7 1736, Jonathan Swift, letter to Alexander Pope I was double their age.

defs.en: Two together; two at a time.
defs.ex: When I met the twins, I thought I was seeing double.

defs.en: Into two halves or sections.
defs.ex: The old man was bent double under his heavy burden.

ja: 二つのことが一緒に、同時に。

defs.en: Twice the number, amount, size, etc.
defs.ex: I did double his sales this month.

defs.en: A person who resembles and stands in for another person, often for safety purposes
defs.ex: Saddam Hussein was rumored to have many doubles.

defs.en: A drink with two portions of alcohol.
defs.ex: On second thought, make that a double.

defs.en: Two shifts of work back to back.
defs.ex: I work a double this weekend.

defs.en: A ghostly apparition of a living person; a doppelgänger.

ja: 二倍、二重（のもの、であること）
そっくりの人、そっくりさん、影武者。
生霊、ドッペルゲンガー。
ダブル、グラスに注がれたウイスキーなどの量。

defs.en: To multiply by two.
defs.ex: The company doubled their earnings per share over last quarter.

defs.en: To increase by 100%, to become twice as large in size.
defs.ex: Our earnings have doubled in the last year.

defs.en: To be the double of; to exceed by twofold; to contain or be worth twice as much as.
To fold over so as to make two folds.
defs.ex: To make a pleat, double the material at the waist.

defs.en: To clench (a fist).

ja: 二倍にする。二を掛ける。

defs.en: In spite of, notwithstanding.
defs.ex: Despite being a near-mirror image my of right, my left hand is terrible at these stuff.

defs.en: Evil feeling; malice, spite, annoyance.
A small quantity of liquid, just large enough to hold its own rounded shape through surface tension, especially one that falls from a source of liquid.
defs.ex: Put three drops of oil into the mixture.

defs.en: A dose of liquid medicine in the form of a drop (sense 1).
A liquid medicine that is intended to be administered in drops (sense 1).
defs.ex: ear drops eye drops

defs.en: A very small quantity of liquid, or (by extension) of anything.
defs.ex: My aunt asked for just a drop more tea.

defs.en: A small amount of an alcoholic beverage.
defs.ex: He usually enjoys a drop after dinner. She won’t touch a drop while she’s on duty.

defs.en: Of a liquid: to fall in drops or droplets.
To fall (straight down) under the influence of gravity, like a drop of liquid.
defs.ex: A single shot was fired and the bird dropped from the sky.

defs.en: Of an item: To appear for the player to pick up, usually after an enemy has been defeated.
defs.ex: When you defeat this boss, there's a chance a power-up will drop.

defs.en: To fall or sink quickly or suddenly to the ground.
defs.ex: Drop and give me thirty push-ups, private!

defs.en: To collapse in exhaustion or injury; also, to fall dead, or to fall in death.

ja: 低下する。下落する。劣化する。減少する。
止める。終える。中断する。
